notes: Both individual principal Belvedere palaces: the complete Upper palace with three raised mansard-roofed central blocks and four domed corner pavilions, and the complete Lower palace with raised central hall, red hipped/mansard roofs and its actual bent rear courtyard ranges. Gardens, ponds, detached annexes and city buildings remain native context. Original exterior geometry; no interiors or copied sculpture. Fine ornaments, window inventories, concealed roof joins and historic grade are original approximations. No copied statues, heraldry or inscriptions. The coarse global elevation field is not surveyed; bounded thresholds approximate contact, not historic stairs. Physical-device timings and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured. Thirty-nine principal parent/part fragments replaced;484 native context components retained.
